extension.name: System - Google Tag Manager
extension.author: HKweb
extension.description: System plugin for Google Tag Manager integration with consent mode support (Joomla 6+)

field.name: container_id
field.label: Container ID
field.description: Enter your GTM Container Public ID (GTM-XXXX)

field.name: server_side_note
field.description: With server-side tagging, tracking requests are routed through your own server before being forwarded to Google Tag Manager. This improves data accuracy, reduces the amount of JavaScript running in the visitor's browser, and gives you full control over what data leaves your infrastructure. Learn more about server-side tagging

field.name: server_side_domain
field.label: Server-side GTM Domain
field.description: Enter the base URL of your server-side GTM instance (e.g. https://sst.example.com). GTM scripts will be loaded from this domain instead of googletagmanager.com.
